items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, so, after, The Russians are Coming, came, Harper, with Paul Newman, from which came, “Sure as You’re Born.” [INTERVIEWEE] Um-hm, which was never meant to be a song but somehow became because that was the era where they turned everything into a song, they just put a lyric to it.

ctx.x: You’re very lucky if they have chords, or if they have more than two or three. Most of them don’t, I just decided never to pay attention to that.
Now, so, after, The Russians are Coming, came, Harper, with Paul Newman, from which came, “Sure as You’re Born.”
Um-hm, which was never meant to be a song but somehow became because that was the era where they turned everything into a song, they just put a lyric to it.
